user.title: Connect to Dynalite PDEG
user.description: Enter the IP address and port of your Philips Dynalite Ethernet Gateway (PDEG).

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Dynalite PDEG
reconfigure.description: Update the host, port or display name. The integration will reload automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the PDEG. Check the IP address and port.
error.timeout: Connection timed out. Ensure the PDEG is reachable on the network.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

init.title: Scan Settings
init.description: Configure the area and channel range used for bus discovery.

areas.title: Manage Areas
areas.description: Add areas by number (comma-separated). Check areas below to remove them.

channels_area.title: Manage Channels
channels_area.description: Select an area to add or configure its channels, or choose Done to finish.

channels_edit.title: Edit Channels — {area_name}
channels_edit.description: Add channels by number (e.g. 0, 1, 2). Select existing channels to change their type or remove them. A reload is required after changing types.

error.invalid_area: Invalid area number — must be between 1 and 255.
error.invalid_channel: Invalid channel number — must be between 0 and 63.
